# Whole review of the microscopic conditional-clock preparation bridge

29 October 2026. Root read BARE_SEEDS_AND_AVERAGING.md,
MICROSCOPIC_COMPOSITION.md and FINITE_RESERVOIR.md in
b_conventional/clock_controller. Root also checked the actual
Scandi--Alhambra arXiv:2505.20064 Theorems11,13,15--18 and
Woods--Cramer--Plenio arXiv:1504.01531 Theorem1 against the composition.
The construction is accepted at its explicitly declared mathematical
apparatus scope, with the qualifications below. It is not hardware data.

operators in the proof vacuum frame. The ground spectral flow becomes
proof-only. Positive time-translation averages preserve the full parent
gap because every conjugate has the same Gibbs/TFD zero vector. The strong
ordinary non-RWA microscopic theorem supplies precisely that finite
Gaussian average at its Lamb-renormalized Hamiltonian. Global filtered-
parent Lipschitz estimates pay the shift with inverse-polynomial bath
coupling, without demanding local-norm qualification or resolving tiny
Bohr spacings. Root checked the displayed source error overpayments and
the real-part contraction in the presence of coherent drift.

shaped one. Its Bose factor is a fixed-filter perturbation polynomial(b)
times exp(-b/2), so the all-cold product argument survives with revised
fixed constants. The explicit derivative recurrence pays its bath moments;
old numerical gates are not reused as if already qualified.

therefore requires polynomial precision bits, not an exact table oracle.
